verdict.rationale: Online company formation and filing is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, both probes hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so none of the service's own published pages were retrieved to show that registration, filing or payment can be completed online. This verdict reflects absence of evidence caused by the access wall, not proof that online filing is missing.
